thesis: The speaker argues that authenticity is a critical, non-negotiable asset for a brand that cannot be purchased with money, a lesson learned while building the Power Bar category against larger conglomerates. Additionally, the speaker describes his personal history as a long-distance runner and his career trajectory from co-founding Power Bar to developing his own ice cream brand, Weiss Cream.
